turns.question: What was the total ad spend on days when the email campaign had no booked lead, from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend restricted to days without an email booking (it cannot filter one metric by another metric's per-day result), so I cannot give that figure for 17 August to 2 October 2026; the closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR) and Bookings, each filterable by campaign channel = email and groupable by day.
